TestAlternatorBackwardsCompatibility::te.description: Single-node upgrade test across upgrade_matrix_for_alternator: creates a table with GSI+LSI on the oldest version, writes one item per upgrade step, then after each node upgrade reads the old item, overwrites it with only keys (must vanish from LSI and GSI), sets new LSI/GSI/data attrs via UpdateItem and verifies the full table scan. TesterAlternator::test_full_scan_table_w.description: 3-node cluster, prefill 100 items, start a background (non-parallel) full Scan loop with ConsistentRead against node1, then stop/start node2 and node3 one at a time. Intended to verify Scan correctness while replicas restart. Scan stress errors are never surfaced: run_scan_stress registers only scan_thread.stop() in clear_resources and the test never joins it, so the future's exception is never read. Moreover full_scan calls self.compare_table_items_data, which has never existed in the dtest repo (git log -S'compare_table_items_data' only hits origin e035960f), so with is_compare_scan_result=True the thread dies with AttributeError after the first scan. Effective checks: nodes restart cleanly and no errors in node logs.
